shortDescription: El Salvador increased its Bitcoin holdings by 8 BTC over the past 7 days and by 31 BTC over the past 30 days. According to ChainCatcher, its total Bitcoin holdings now stand at 7,787.37 BTC, with a total value of $658 million.
